name: model
description: Every model, one market: BYOK gateway over 17 providers (incl. SayGM) + your own OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Same model from every provider grouped into a market (offers cheapest first, spread), and ONE OpenAI-standard API at /v1 for all of them — non-OpenAI shapes (Anthropic messages, Gemini generateContent, responses) are translated both ways.

/models.docs: List models for ?provider=ID (BYOK via X-API-Key; openrouter public)

/catalog.docs: Combined catalog of every type: each model has ref <provider>:<model>, kind, price_in/out (USD per 1M), context. Keys via X-API-Keys JSON; ?search= ?kind=; custom endpoints via X-Custom-Providers

/chat.docs: Streaming chat (SSE). Body: {model:"<provider>:<model>", messages} or {provider, model, messages}; BYOK via X-API-Key or X-API-Keys

/check.docs: Validate a key: ?provider=ID with X-API-Key -> {ok, count}

/images.docs: Text to image {model:ref, prompt, size, n} -> {images:[url|data:]}

/speech.docs: TTS {model:ref, input, voice, format} -> audio bytes

/market.docs: Market board: one row per canonical model, offers from every provider sorted by blended $/1M ((3*in+out)/4), n venues, best, spread. ?kind= ?search= ?min_offers=

/v1/models.docs: OpenAI list shape; ids are <provider>:<model> refs with pricing/kind/market extras

/v1/chat/completions.docs: OpenAI chat completions for EVERY provider (stream, tools, images). model=<provider>:<model>, or a bare name -> cheapest provider you sent a key for in X-API-Keys. Response header X-Model-Ref says where it went
